summary: Check a signed module manifest in three places
description: SEC-19 and SEC-20. A mismatched file hash fails the manifest check and the license state to apply is invalid. Gateway, reporting, and MCP each call cached_license_state.

constraints: Do not ignore a hash mismatch.

Do not print file contents in the failure result.
